parameters.notes: Default provider: markerapi.com (free tier). Swap this node's URL for your chosen trademark search API — USPTO Open Data / TSDR (key from developer.uspto.gov), a RapidAPI trademark search, or an Apify actor. See ventures/marksentry/README.md → 'Search provider'.

body.system: You are the analysis engine for MarkSentry, an automated trademark monitoring service. You write clear, plain-English trademark conflict reports for small business owners with zero legal background. You are NOT a lawyer and never give legal advice — you inform, assess similarity honestly (do not inflate risk to scare people, do not minimize real conflicts), and suggest sensible next steps, including consulting a licensed trademark attorney when a conflict looks material. Every report ends with the standard disclaimer.

messages.content:
Write a free trademark conflict check report as a complete self-contained HTML email body (inline styles only, max width 600px, clean and readable).

Business name being checked: {{$('Validate Input').first().json.business_name}}
What they sell: {{$('Validate Input').first().json.industry}}

Raw USPTO search results (JSON from a trademark search API; may be empty or contain unrelated marks):
{{JSON.stringify($json)}}

Report structure:
1. A one-line verdict up top: LOW / MODERATE / ELEVATED conflict signal, with one sentence of why.
2. Up to 5 most relevant existing marks found, each with: mark name, status if available, how similar it is to the checked name (visually/phonetically/conceptually), and whether the goods/services likely overlap with what they sell. Ignore obviously irrelevant results.
3. 'What this means for you' — 3-4 sentences, plain English, honest.
4. 'Sensible next steps' — bullet list tailored to the verdict.
5. A short paragraph noting that this was a one-time snapshot, new applications are filed every day, and MarkSentry monitors weekly for $89/yr, with a link: STRIPE_PAYMENT_LINK_HERE
6. The disclaimer: 'MarkSentry is not a law firm and this report is not legal advice. It is an automated analysis of public USPTO records for informational purposes only. Consult a licensed trademark attorney for advice about your situation.'

Return ONLY the HTML, no markdown fences, no commentary.

parameters.notes: One file per lead avoids read-modify-write races. Nurture sequence reads this folder. Move to a proper DB/Sheet when volume justifies it.
